text:
Situation: Our three sites hold 20, 17, and 10 days of aztreonam supply. The product we use is labeled by A-S Medication Solutions and manufactured at FEI 1450743.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists FEI 1450743 as a registered plant. Its most recent inspection ended 2026-08-12 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2026-10-14. The plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and VAI inspections in 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2018. Aztreonam is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory is low and the sole source plant has a history of VAI classifications and a prior Warning Letter. We need to secure alternative supply immediately.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C. (plant: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company Princeton). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspection VAI 2023-10-13). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate Hospira, Inc. supply (label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA listing changes.
